note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Research limitation: the web_search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' for every query during this session, so no targeted sanctions-list, court-database, regulator or news searches could be executed. Direct fetches of CRISIL, ICRA, CARE, India Ratings and BSE pages returned 404s, timeouts or JS-only shells with no usable content. Consequently sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null = NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED BY ME, not evidence of absence. What was actually confirmed: sandhargroup.com is live and identifies Sandhar Technologies Limited as an NSE-listed (ticker SANDHAR) Indian auto-component manufacturer, corporate office Plot 13, Sector-44, Gurugram, Haryana; site lists 41 years of operation, multiple manufacturing facilities and JVs, and a March 2025 announcement that wholly-owned subsidiary Sandhar Ascast Pvt Ltd acquired the aluminium die-casting business of Sundaram-Clayton Ltd at Hosur. That is a corporate/expansion signal only, not a risk finding. No sanctions exposure, no Indian court case, no regulator action, no credit rating action and no Russia/CIS supply evidence could be located or ruled out with the tools available. Per project rules, nothing here is a rejection ground; sanctions/court/criminal matters would in any case be recorded neutrally as 'есть сложности'. Recommend re-running this company once search connectivity is restored, specifically against OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List, NCLT/NCLAT and High Court dockets, SEBI orders, and rating-agency press releases.
